data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate has strengthened prior year reserves by $1.4m during 2018 (2017: release of $26.5m).

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse claims experience on 2016 and prior years
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development on 2016 and prior years leading to a strengthening of prior year reserves

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3623 strengthened prior year reserves by $1.4m in 2018, driven by adverse claims experience on 2016 and prior years. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were $385.8m. The prior year strengthening represents approximately 0.36% of opening gross claims reserves. The movement is stated in the managing agent's strategic report and affects the syndicate's accident & health and reinsurance/specialty lines divisions.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate has strengthened prior year reserves by $1.4m during 2018 (2017: release of $26.5m).
This loss was primarily driven by some adverse claims experience on 2016 and prior years of account during the year.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, 31 Dec 2017 = 385.8). No explicit GROSS prior-year movement line was found; the report gives an explicit narrative statement of a $1.4m strengthening (likely a NET figure). Per extraction rules, the gross prior-year movement was not available, so the reported prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the explicitly stated $1.4m figure from the managing agent's narrative (net-of-reinsurance status not explicitly stated). LOB-level prior-year movements are not quantified in the report and are inferred from divisional commentary; amounts per LOB are therefore null. The claims development triangle is present in the notes but detailed development-period amount rows were not provided in the extract (only current estimates by underwriting year), so triangle-based PYD calculation was not possible.
